Here is a quick summary of how our returns and refunds work, plus the key points to know.
Returns
UK returns are free.
Return within 30 days of receipt in original condition and we will refund the amount you paid.
Sale items: please register your return within 14 days using our online returns portal, then you have a further 14 days to send it back in original condition.
Non-refundable for hygiene reasons: swimwear if the hygiene strip has been removed, and earrings if the internal packaging seal has been broken.
If you return an item from an order that still has a pre-order item outstanding, the cost of the outstanding item may be deducted from your refund, with the remaining balance refunded to your original payment method.
We do not offer exchanges. Simply return for a refund and place a new order online so you can see up-to-date availability.
Refunds
We will refund what you paid for the returned item, in line with our returns policy and any promotion or discount applied at the time of purchase.
Refunds are made to your original payment method.
365-day quality guarantee
After our standard 30-day period (or 14 days for sale items), you can return anything that does not meet our quality standards up to one year after your order arrived.
Faulty items: within 6 months of receipt we will refund; between 6 and 12 months we will credit your account for the amount paid. Account credit has no expiry and can be used on any future order. If an item was purchased with a discount or offer, we will adjust the refund accordingly.
